chunks: Begin with salt at the start of the meal, for if people knew what is in salt, they would prefer it over the tried remedy.

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: the title of Imam Ali عليه السلام, Commander of the Faithful
key_terms.الْمُجَرَّبِ: tried, tested, or proven by experience
key_terms.الْمِلْحِ: salt, recommended here at the beginning of eating
key_terms.اِبْدَءُوا: begin; a directive to start in this manner

ai.seo_question: What does Amir al-Mu'minin Ali ibn Abi Talib عليه السلام say about beginning food with salt?
ai.summary: This hadith from Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام teaches an etiquette of eating: beginning the meal with salt. It presents salt as possessing benefit so significant that, if people truly knew it, they would prefer it over a proven remedy.
